messages:
maria-support: Heads-up — AcmeProd on dedicated pool reported intermittent 429s starting ~09:12 UTC after last night's quota rollover. They say traffic is normal and only ~10-20% of calls return 429 while rest succeed.
kevin-eng: Can you paste one of the failing response headers and a sample request?
rachael-cs: Customer provided this snippet, they hit our /v1/generate endpoint with their tenant token.
maria-support: ```
> curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_acme_XXXX' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://dedicated-us.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RDW-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RDW-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RDW-RateLimit-Reset: 13
Retry-After: 13
```
liam-sre: Interesting that headers show Limit=1200 and Remaining=0 but only some requests hit 0. Could be inconsistent per-replica enforcement / stale mapping.
kevin-eng: I pulled routing traces for the tenant token — requests are being spread across 6 replicas in the dedicated pool. 3 replicas report quota_profile=v2, 3 report quota_profile=v1. Looks like a partial quota-profile rollout.
maria-support: @liam-sre is that possible after a quota config change? we did a config push last night.
liam-sre: Yes — rollout started but the mapping cache wasn't invalidated on warm nodes. New nodes picked up v2 (higher limits), older warm nodes still enforcing v1 (lower limits). When load gets sharded unevenly you get "staggered" 429 behavior.
deploy-bot: rollout:quota-profiles-redwood - status: partial - succeeded: 3/6 - failed: 0 - pending cache refresh: 3
ana-ops: Typo: we set v1 limit in minutes, and v2 in seconds for a similar field during the profile migration. That combined with inconsistent cache produced effective mismatched denominators.
kevin-eng: Example of the bad YAML we pushed (redacted):
```yaml
quota_profiles:
  v1:
    rate: 200
    unit: minute
  v2:
    rate: 4
    unit: second
```
kevin-eng: Both intend to be ~200/min but engine treats unit literally, so v2 became 240/min — but because of cache mismatch some replicas were still on the old 200/min mapping while others were on 240/min. 
maria-support: Customer workload is bursty; when requests hit the lower-replica side they got throttled while other requests succeeded.
rachael-cs: Customer is understandably upset, says it impacts production. They've asked for immediate mitigation and permanent fix.
liam-sre: Immediate mitigation steps I ran: 1) force cache invalidate for tenant mapping on all replicas 2) cold-restart 3) temporarily increase v1 to match intended rate while we reconcile units. Commands:
```
rdwctl quota cache flush --tenant acme-prod
rdwctl deploy restart --pool dedicated-us --filter 'quota_profile=v1'
```
liam-sre: I triggered cache flush + restart on the 3 stale nodes ~09:28 UTC. After that customer reported success and 429s dropped to near zero.
kevin-eng: We should add a safety check in deploy pipeline to reject quota profile pushes when unit fields differ across versions or when rollout targets mix old/new mappings.
nana-ops: Agreed. Also scheduling a post-deploy job to verify per-replica mapping parity.
deploy-bot: patch:quota-rollout-check added to CI - will block if unit mismatch detected (soft flag until next release).
maria-support: Customer asked for root cause summary and queryable timeline. I'll send an interim note: partial rollout + unit mismatch + stale mapping on warm nodes caused inconsistent per-replica rate enforcement -> intermittent 429s.
rachael-cs: Please include the temporary mitigation steps and ETA for full fix.
liam-sre: Next actions (short):
- Reconcile v1/v2 units to unified unit (done locally, will push change)
- Add automated parity check to rollout (PR open #4521)
- Add a monitoring alert for per-tenant variance in X-RDW-RateLimit-Remaining across pool replicas (dashboard ticket created)
- Run a controlled canary of quota-profile rollout with verification hook
kevin-eng: Repro steps for eng to validate locally: run 200 parallel requests spread over 6 replicas (we have a helper):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_acme_XXXX" -d '{"input":"p"}' https://dedicated-us.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
  sleep 0.01
done; wait
```
kevin-eng: Watch X-RDW-RateLimit-Remaining. If you see two distinct windows (e.g., ~0 and ~50) across replicas we reproduced the staggered fallback.
maria-support: Customer follow-up scheduled at 14:00 UTC. I'll share the mitigation and timeline.
rachael-cs: Thanks — once fixed please share final RCA and the change request so legal/compliance can archive.
liam-sre: I'll open the postmortem draft and attach logs + rollout traces.
kevin-eng: Leaving a note: no billing impact discovered; this is enforcement-only.
maria-support: Closing loop here after we confirm the full rollout parity is green. :thumbsup:
